name: keyfixer
description: A privacy-first Arabic and English keyboard layout correction tool for the web and Chrome.

scripts.build:desktop: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist-desktop/index-desktop.html', 'dist-desktop/index.html'); if(process.env.VITE_PRO_BUILD === 'true') require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-desktop/ACTIVE_PRO_BUILD_MARKER_9921', 'pro')"
scripts.build:pro:mac: VITE_PRO_BUILD=true tsc -b && VITE_PRO_BUILD=true vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist-desktop/index-desktop.html', 'dist-desktop/index.html')" && tauri build --bundles app --features pro
scripts.build:appstore:prepare: npm run build:appstore:clean && VITE_PRO_BUILD=true npm run build:desktop && VITE_PRO_BUILD=true npm run preflight:desktop
scripts.build:appstore: npm run build:appstore:prepare && npm run build:appstore:tauri && npm run verify:appstore:postbuild
scripts.build:extension: npm run typecheck:extension && npm run build && node extension-build.js
scripts.release:check: npm run version:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run build:extension
